name: Wall
doc: Wall (the magic, Selphie's Slot): the root and the main task - the stage captured, the 24 shards on an ellipse, the wall rising through its plane (the camera shake), the dust and debris, the sound; the action results. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag189_wall.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, capture packets and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The stage captured, the 24 shards on an ellipse, the wall rising through its plane (the camera shake), the dust and debris, the sound; the action results

params.label: Result tick
params.doc: The action results at this tick of the main task

params.label: Dust
params.doc: The sprite sequence dust (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Wall model
params.doc: The prim model wall (a mesh of 144 vertices, 250 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))
